title: Survey effort as a behavioral proxy for grit and self-control

description: The article advances a methodological framework that treats attrition and academic probation as time-to-event outcomes modeled with semi-parametric multivariable Cox proportional hazards models, rather than as dichotomous variables measured at a single point.
title: Survival analysis for modeling educational attrition and academic difficulty as time-to-event outcomes
